shortDescription: Manage rulebook activations in the EDA Controller

options.name: awx_token_name
options.description: The token ID of the AWX controller.

options.name: controller_host
options.description: The URL of the EDA controller. If not set, the value of C(CONTROLLER_HOST), or E(AAP_HOSTNAME) environment variables will be used. Support for E(AAP_HOSTNAME) has been added in version 2.7.

options.name: controller_password
options.description: Password used for authentication. If not set, the value of C(CONTROLLER_PASSWORD), or E(AAP_PASSWORD) environment variables will be used. Support for E(AAP_PASSWORD) has been added in version 2.7.

options.name: controller_token
options.description: Token used for authentication. If not set, the value of C(CONTROLLER_TOKEN), E(AAP_TOKEN), or E(AAP_OAUTH_TOKEN) environment variables will be used. Support for E(CONTROLLER_TOKEN), E(AAP_TOKEN), and E(AAP_OAUTH_TOKEN) has been added in version 2.10.

options.name: controller_username
options.description: Username used for authentication. If not set, the value of C(CONTROLLER_USERNAME), or E(AAP_USERNAME) environment variables will be used. Support for E(AAP_USERNAME) has been added in version 2.7.

options.name: decision_environment_name
options.description: The name of the decision environment associated with the rulebook activation. Required when state is present.

options.name: description
options.description: The description of the rulebook activation.

options.name: eda_credentials
options.description: A list of IDs for EDA credentials used by the rulebook activation. This parameter is supported in AAP 2.5 and onwards. If specified for AAP 2.4, value will be ignored.

options.name: enable_persistence
options.description: Enable event persistence for this activation.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the rulebook activation is enabled or not. This field will be removed in version 3.0.0. The logic of controlling the state of an activation is going to be controlled by the C(state) parameter itself.

options.name: event_streams
options.description: A list of event stream names that this rulebook activation listens to. This parameter is supported in AAP 2.5 and onwards. If specified for AAP 2.4, value will be ignored.

options.name: extra_vars
options.description: The extra variables for the rulebook activation.

options.name: k8s_service_name
options.description: The name of the Kubernetes service associated with this rulebook activation. This parameter is supported in AAP 2.5 and onwards. If specified for AAP 2.4, value will be ignored.

options.name: log_level
options.description: Allow setting the desired log level. This parameter is supported in AAP 2.5 and onwards. If specified for AAP 2.4, value will be ignored.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the rulebook activation.

options.name: new_name
options.description: Renames an existing rulebook activation. If set, the rulebook activation will be updated with the new name.

options.name: organization_name
options.description: The name of the organization. Required when state is present. This parameter is supported in AAP 2.5 and onwards. If specified for AAP 2.4, value will be ignored.

options.name: project_name
options.description: The name of the project associated with the rulebook activation. Required when state is present.

options.name: request_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for the connection with the EDA controller. If not set, the value of C(CONTROLLER_TIMEOUT), E(AAP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT) environment variables will be used. Support for E(AAP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT) has been added in version 2.7.

options.name: restart
options.description: Performs a restart of the activation. This is a non idempotent operation. If enabled the rest of parameters will be ignored.

options.name: restart_on_project_update
options.description: Used to indicate if an activation should restart after a project update.

options.name: restart_policy
options.description: The restart policy for the rulebook activation.

options.name: rule_engine_credential_id
options.description: The ID of the Event-Driven Ansible Rule Engine Credential. Optional parameter. When omitted, the field will not be sent in the request.

options.name: rulebook_name
options.description: The name of the rulebook associated with the rulebook activation. Required when state is present.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the resource. The state of an activation itself is controlled by this parameter, whether I(enabled) or I(disabled). When an activation is created, it is I(enabled) by default. Thus, I(present) is equivalent to I(enabled). Whether I(present), I(enabled), or I(disabled) is specified, an activation will be created if it doesn't exist already. To create a disabled activation, specify C(state) as I(disabled). Essentially, this parameter deprecates the usage of C(enabled).

options.name: swap_single_source
options.description: Allow swapping of single sources in a rulebook without name match. This parameter is no longer used and is going to be ignored. This field will be removed in version 3.0.0.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to allow insecure connections to Ansible Automation Platform EDA Controller instance. If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_VERIFY_SSL), or E(AAP_VALIDATE_CERTS). Support for E(AAP_VALIDATE_CERTS) has been added in version 2.7.
